article_title: Labubu sales are slumping. Is the craze over?

tasks.prompt: What is the central argument of the article?
options: Labubu's viral boom is weakening as sales, scarcity and online attention fall, leaving Pop Mart to prove it can build an enduring character brand
Blind boxes have been made illegal in most countries
Pop Mart has stopped producing Labubu dolls entirely
Collectors agree that all toy trends last forever
tasks.correct_answer: Labubu's viral boom is weakening as sales, scarcity and online attention fall, leaving Pop Mart to prove it can build an enduring character brand
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה טוענת שהגל הוויראלי נחלש, ושהאתגר של Pop Mart הוא להפוך הצלחה רגעית למותג ודמות בעלי חיים ארוכים.

tasks.prompt: What sales change did Pop Mart report for the three months to the end of September?
options: Sales doubled in every region.
Global sales fell by as much as 50% from the previous year, with US revenue down by at least 70%.
Only sales in mainland China fell.
US revenue remained unchanged.
tasks.correct_answer: Global sales fell by as much as 50% from the previous year, with US revenue down by at least 70%.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: החברה דיווחה על ירידה של עד 50% במכירות העולמיות לעומת השנה הקודמת, ובארה״ב על ירידה של לפחות 70%.

tasks.prompt: What does the article mean when it says the craze may be “running out of steam”?
options: Factories have run out of electricity.
The dolls are becoming physically warmer.
The trend is losing momentum and public excitement.
Collectors are repairing old steam engines.
tasks.correct_answer: The trend is losing momentum and public excitement.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: Running out of steam פירושו לאבד תנופה ואנרגיה; כאן הכוונה לירידה בהתלהבות ובעניין הציבורי.

tasks.prompt: Why did increasing production weaken part of Labubu's appeal?
options: It made every doll more expensive to manufacture.
It prevented celebrities from owning the toys.
It removed the blind-box format.
It reduced scarcity, so finding a Labubu no longer felt exclusive.
tasks.correct_answer: It reduced scarcity, so finding a Labubu no longer felt exclusive.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: כאשר הייצור גדל והמוצרים נעשו זמינים יותר, תחושת הנדירות והבלעדיות שעודדה קנייה חוזרת נחלשה.

tasks.prompt: Which development shows Pop Mart trying to expand Labubu beyond toy sales?
options: It opened a theme park in Beijing and announced a Labubu film.
It closed all shops outside China.
It sold the character to Sanrio.
It replaced Labubu with Marvel products.
tasks.correct_answer: It opened a theme park in Beijing and announced a Labubu film.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: Pop Mart הקימה פארק שעשועים בבייג׳ינג והכריזה על סרט Labubu בניסיון לבנות מותג רחב יותר סביב הדמות.

tasks.prompt: What does Barbero mean when she says she is “curating” her collection?
options: She is selling every doll immediately.
She is displaying the collection in a national museum.
She is choosing additions carefully for lasting personal value rather than buying every new release.
She is designing blind boxes for Pop Mart.
tasks.correct_answer: She is choosing additions carefully for lasting personal value rather than buying every new release.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: Curating כאן פירושו לבחור בקפידה פריטים שמתאימים לאוסף ושיישארו אהובים לאורך זמן, במקום לרדוף אחר כל סדרה חדשה.

tasks.prompt: Give five signs that the Labubu craze has cooled.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין חמישה סימנים נפרדים הנתמכים בנתוני מכירות, שוק, רשתות או התנהגות אספנים.
expected_points: Global quarterly sales fell by as much as 50% year on year.
US revenue fell by at least 70%.
Pop Mart shares had fallen more than 50% from the previous year's peak.
Ensito's videos struggle to reach the views they once gained quickly.
Lawrence Yu rarely makes Labubu videos after clips once drew up to a million views.
Collectors say they are becoming more selective.
More dolls are readily available in shops, weakening scarcity.
Rival blind-box characters are gaining popularity.

tasks.prompt: Explain the difference between a viral product and an enduring character franchise, using the article's comparison with Disney or Sanrio.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להבחין בין התלהבות רגעית לנאמנות ארוכת טווח ולהשתמש בהשוואת סיפור־דמות־מוצר.
expected_points: A viral product can grow quickly through social media, celebrity visibility and scarcity.
An enduring franchise gives consumers stories, characters and emotional attachment that survive a trend.
Sanrio benefits from the long-established appeal of Hello Kitty.
Disney often sells a story before selling merchandise.
Pop Mart is trying to work in reverse by building stories and experiences around an already popular toy.
Its test is whether people will love Labubu without celebrity or trend-driven exposure.

tasks.prompt: Summarise Labubu's rise, the reasons for its slowdown, Pop Mart's response and collectors' changing behaviour in 5–6 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול קופסאות הפתעה ונדירות, נתוני ירידה, תחרות, ניסיונות הרחבת המותג ותגובות שונות של אספנים.
expected_points: Blind boxes, rare versions, social media and celebrity use helped Labubu become a global craze.
Rapid expansion reduced scarcity, while views, sales and share value later declined.
Rivals such as Sonny Angels, Smiski and Miniso products are competing for attention.
Pop Mart is investing in a theme park and film to turn the toy into a broader franchise.
Some collectors now buy more selectively or move to other trends.
Devoted fans still value the dolls for personal happiness rather than viral status.

tasks.prompt: Write a strategic recommendation for Pop Mart on how to make Labubu durable without depending on artificial scarcity.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציע אסטרטגיה מעשית הנשענת על עובדות הכתבה ומתייחסת לסיפור, לקהילה, לאיכות, לתחרות ולמדידת נאמנות.
expected_points: Develop strong stories and personalities around Labubu through film or other media.
Create experiences that deepen attachment rather than relying only on hard-to-find releases.
Maintain design quality and value for money as competitors expand.
Support genuine fan communities while avoiding pressure to buy every series.
Use repeat engagement and long-term customer loyalty, not only viral views, as measures of success.
Keep product availability balanced without making mass production erase all sense of discovery.
